risk_threshold_medium.description: Score at which a message is shown as 'Be careful'.

risk_threshold_high.description: Score at which a message is shown as 'This looks like a scam'.

rule_weight_overrides.description: JSON object of rule id -> weight (0 to 0.95), e.g. {"urgency":0.3}. 0 disables a rule.

cloud_enabled.description: Kill switch for the cloud route. false = device or rules only, for everyone.

cloud_model.description: Gemini model used for the cloud fallback.

prompt_version.description: Shown in Settings; bump when the prompt changes.

extra_rules.description: JSON array of live rules: {id, category, label, why, weight, pattern}. See README 'Scam of the week'.

scam_of_the_week.description: Short warning shown on the check screen.
